rules.title: Expected value is computed and recorded with the decision
rules.description: Every decision records expected value per unit staked, and it recomputes from the recorded price and discounted edge by both available routes.
rules.rationale: Expected value is the summary the decision rule reads. Recording it makes the arithmetic checkable; computing it two ways makes a transposed input show up as an inconsistency rather than as a plausible figure.
rules.remediation: Recompute expected value from the recorded price and discounted edge.
rules.$assuranceNote: Full assurance that the value follows from its recorded inputs by both routes.

rules.title: Nothing is called positive expected value without the calculation behind it
rules.description: No output describes a wager as positive EV, or +EV, unless it resolves to a decision record carrying the probability and price the claim rests on.
rules.rationale: '+EV' is the phrase that ends arguments. Used without the arithmetic it is a claim of rigour rather than an instance of it, and it is most persuasive exactly where it is least earned.
rules.remediation: Either produce the decision record with the probability and price behind the claim, or drop the claim.
rules.$assuranceNote: Scans recorded prose for EV claims that do not resolve to a calculation. Outputs outside the ledger — a message, a conversation, a spreadsheet — are not visible to this check at all.

rules.title: Expected value is never fabricated
rules.description: No expected value is stated that does not follow from a recorded probability, price, and stake.
rules.rationale: An invented expected value is worse than none: it carries the authority of a calculation while having none of the substance, and it is the number a reader is least likely to check.
rules.remediation: Recompute expected value from the recorded inputs, or correct the inputs to those actually used.
rules.$assuranceNote: Detects an expected value inconsistent with its recorded inputs. One computed correctly from fabricated inputs passes here.
